summary: The bill amends existing law to modify repayment for the Arkansas Valley Conduit in Colorado by requiring payment of 35 percent of costs through non-federal construction funding plus up to 75 years of repayment at half the standard interest rate for financially distressed communities, while assigning operations and maintenance to the contracting parties.

scores.thoughts: The bill modifies repayment terms for a federal reclamation project (Arkansas Valley Conduit), extending the repayment period to 75 years at a reduced interest rate and allowing non-federal funding during construction. These changes reduce the immediate financial burden on local entities and facilitate project completion, which has the effect of expanding or subsidizing federal infrastructure spending relative to standard reclamation law terms.
